SELECT dr.id, dr.resource_name, dr.resource_url, dr.resource_size, dr.resource_type, dr.resource_format, dr.resource_description, dr.resource_tags, dr.resource_status, dr.resource_creator, ui.user_name as resource_creator_name, ui.image as resource_creator_avatar, dr.resource_update_time, dr.resource_create_time, dr.resource_is_public, dr.resource_bind_content_id, dr.resource_bind_content_type, dr.vip_resource, dr.download_count FROM download_resource dr left join user_info ui on dr.resource_creator = ui.user_id WHERE dr.resource_status = 1 and dr.resource_is_public = 1
AND dr.resource_type in
#{categoryName}
AND dr.resource_name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
AND dr.vip_resource = 1
AND ( dr.resource_create_time < #{lastCreateTime} OR ( dr.resource_create_time = #{lastCreateTime} AND dr.id < #{lastId} ) )
ORDER BY dr.resource_create_time DESC, dr.id DESC LIMIT #{size}

select dr.id, dr.resource_name, dr.resource_url, dr.resource_size, dr.resource_type, dr.resource_format, dr.resource_description, dr.resource_tags, dr.resource_status, dr.resource_creator, ui.user_name as resource_creator_name, ui.image as resource_creator_avatar, dr.resource_update_time, dr.resource_create_time, dr.resource_is_public, dr.resource_bind_content_id, dr.resource_bind_content_type, dr.vip_resource, dr.download_count from download_resource dr left join user_info ui on dr.resource_creator = ui.user_id where dr.resource_status = 1 and dr.resource_is_public = 1
and dr.resource_name like concat('%', #{resourceName}, '%')
order by resource_create_time desc

select ui.id, ui.user_id, ui.user_name, ui.sex, ui.image, ui.introduction, ui.region, ui.birth_date, ui.profession, ui.is_vip, ui.exp, ui.create_time, ui.update_time from user_info ui where ui.user_id = #{userId}
